cases.title: SEC bankruptcy filing becomes a verified downside-risk event
cases.description: A discovery headline is followed by a P0 SEC filing passage. The same router used by live processing should escalate it for risk review.

observations.title: Company reportedly prepares a court-supervised restructuring
observations.passage: A news summary says the issuer may seek bankruptcy protection, but no primary filing is yet available.

observations.title: Issuer files Form 8-K under Item 1.03
observations.passage: The company disclosed that it and certain subsidiaries filed voluntary petitions for relief under Chapter 11 and will operate as debtors in possession while pursuing a court-supervised restructuring.

cases.title: Positive earnings announcement remains outside the downside-risk queue
cases.description: Full-polarity ingestion is preserved, while the specialized risk router marks ordinary positive news as non-target rather than inventing a bearish conclusion.

observations.title: Company raises guidance after record revenue
observations.passage: The company reported record revenue, profit growth and results above estimates, and management raised full-year guidance while announcing a new partnership.

cases.title: Conflicting rumor and correction force abstention
cases.description: A low-authority bankruptcy rumor is contradicted by a primary issuer statement. Conflict handling caps confidence and prevents an alert.

observations.title: Unverified post claims imminent bankruptcy
observations.passage: An anonymous social post claims the company will file for bankruptcy and default on its obligations this week.

observations.title: Issuer denies bankruptcy rumor
observations.passage: The issuer states that the circulating bankruptcy claim is false and that it has not filed a petition or defaulted on the referenced obligations.

cases.title: SEC filing correction withdraws an initially alert-eligible risk claim
cases.description: A P0 filing first makes a Chapter 11 claim alert-eligible. A later P0 correction explicitly supersedes that observation, creates a primary-source conflict and forces abstention instead of preserving a stale alert.

observations.title: Issuer files Form 8-K under Item 1.03
observations.passage: The filing states that the issuer commenced a voluntary case under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code.

observations.title: Corrected Form 8-K withdraws Item 1.03 disclosure
observations.passage: The amended filing states that Item 1.03 was selected in error, the issuer has not filed a bankruptcy petition, and the earlier disclosure is withdrawn and superseded.
